SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
       ROUND(AVG(t.order_amount), 2) AS avg_order_amount
FROM (
  SELECT order_id, SUM(price) AS order_amount
  FROM order_items
  GROUP BY order_id
) t
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = t.order_id
WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
LIMIT 1000;
